$comment: In-vitro test fixture for the Snapmaker U1 adapter. The adapter OWNS its fake device: this file plus `skeleton/` (a verbatim seed tree) plus ../jinni/paths.json fully define the device the generic runner stands up; the harness and test specs know nothing U1-specific. Placeholders ($BESPOK3D, $KLIPPER_EXTRAS, ...) resolve against paths.json so paths are declared once. `skeleton.dirs`/`skeleton.files` are for empty dirs and tiny inline content; `skeleton.seed` names a directory mirroring the device root, docker-cp'd in verbatim, for real captured files (boot scripts, factory configs). The seed files here were captured from a U1 firmware rootfs and SANITIZED to read as STOCK (Bespok3d targets stock; the enroll preflight refuses Extended firmware): no /usr/local/bin/extended-config.py, the [include extended/...] line stripped from moonraker.conf, FULLVERSION pinned to a stock value. Re-seed from a real stock capture when hardware is available and treat any in-vitro/on-device divergence as a bug in this fixture.
